take: Per the Hurricanes' announcement, Taylor Hall was reinstated from injured reserve and Skyler Brind'Amour was assigned to Chicago (AHL). Hall returns after missing 5 games, and in that stretch Nikolaj Ehlers has played beside Stankoven and Blake, with Jesperi Kotkaniemi up to 13:23 a night and William Carrier up to 14:37. Hall brings a 63% share of the 5-on-5 chance quality (expected goals) and 3 goals in 8 games, for a CAR team sitting at 9-2-2.
